items.title: Widerspruch (appeal) against the Änderungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Wednesday 15.10.2025, presumed handed to the post on that date. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X a written administrative act sent by post is deemed notified (bekanntgegeben) on the 3rd day after posting: 15.10. + 3 days = 18.10.2025, a Saturday. Since the 3rd day falls on a Saturday, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X shifts Bekanntgabe to the next Werktag, i.e. Monday 20.10.2025. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG in conjunction with § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X and §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB) then ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the notifying event, i.e. 20.11.2025 (Thursday). 20.11.2025 is not a Saturday, Sunday or Sachsen public holiday (Buß- und Bettag fell on 19.11.2025), so no further shift applies.
